survey: Round clock standing upright on its rim on a green floor in front of a striped wall. The camera is at about the clock's centre height, with the floor seen slightly from above. The orange rim and white dial face the camera almost straight on. The rim's thickness shows a little more on the right edge, so the clock may be turned very slightly. The dial is close to a circle, slightly taller than wide, which fits that small turn. The 12/6 and 3/9 ticks sit evenly around the centre, and the hour, minute and seconds hands share one central hub. The bottom of the rim touches the floor, and a soft elliptical shadow spreads flat along the floor, matching the slightly-above view of the ground.
